name: Podhradí (Zlín District, Czechia)
description: Navy blue field with an embattled border divided white and red, bearing a yellow plum branch with two plums.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 7 October 2003 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.

features.role: embattled border divided white and red
